market_summary: Global markets fell sharply on October 31 as concerns over AI profitability and capital spending intensified. The Nasdaq dropped 2.9% and S&P 500 fell 1.8% following disappointing tech earnings and profit warnings. Amazon missed Q3 expectations with negative free cash flow despite strong cloud growth, while concerns about massive AI infrastructure investments with unclear returns pressured tech stocks. Asian markets opened lower on November 2, with the Nikkei falling 0.5% and Kospi down 1.4%, tracking Wall Street's losses. Apple earnings are due after market close today, with analysts expecting $1.99 EPS on $113.31B revenue. US midterm elections on November 3 add to market uncertainty.

items.headline: Apple Q4 2026 Earnings Due Today After Market Close
items.summary: Apple is scheduled to report Q4 2026 earnings on November 2 after the close. Analysts forecast earnings of $1.99 per share on $113.31 billion in revenue, up 9-11% year-over-year.

items.headline: Amazon Q3 Earnings Miss Expectations; Reports Negative Free Cash Flow
items.summary: Amazon reported Q3 2026 EPS of $1.89 versus $1.97 expected and revenue of $201.94B versus $202.22B expected. Aggressive AI spending drove negative free cash flow of $42.4B for the trailing twelve months. AWS revenue grew 39% to $46B but retail growth slowed.

items.headline: Nasdaq Falls 2.9% on AI Profitability Concerns; Major Tech Selloff
items.summary: The Nasdaq composite fell 2.9% and S&P 500 dropped 1.8% on October 31, marking the worst day since June. The decline was driven by concerns over massive AI infrastructure spending by major tech companies without clear paths to profitability. Microsoft's results showed strong cloud demand, but Alphabet and Amazon reinforced investor concerns.

items.headline: Alphabet Stock Plunges on AI Spending Concerns; Market Questions Search Growth
items.summary: Alphabet lost about $500 billion on Thursday in its post-earnings selloff as search growth slowed to 12%. Google's AI investment spending drew investor scrutiny following disappointing earnings report, contributing to the broad tech selloff.

items.headline: Reddit Stock Crashes 29% on Google AI Traffic Warning
items.summary: Reddit stock fell 29% on October 31, its worst day ever, wiping out $7 billion in market value. CEO Steve Huffman warned that search referral traffic from Google was down meaningfully due to AI Mode and AI Overviews. Despite 53% revenue growth to $895M, U.S. daily users fell 2%.

items.headline: Asian Markets Decline Amid AI Investment Concerns
items.summary: Asian share markets slipped on November 2 as worries about AI investment sustainability weighed on tech stocks. MSCI's Asia-Pacific index outside Japan eased 0.4%, Japan's Nikkei fell 0.54%, and South Korea's Kospi dropped 1.39%, tracking Wall Street's losses from October 31.
